faqs.answer: For a standard single-family home (150 m²), expect between €18,000 and €28,000 for the drilling and the complete installation (heat pump included). The Luxembourg government's Klimabonus grant can cover up to €10,000 of the amount.
faqs.question: How much does a geothermal installation cost in total in Luxembourg?

faqs.answer: Closed-loop geothermal can be used on almost any Luxembourg plot. Access for the drilling rig (min. 2.5 m wide) is the only practical constraint. WDD carries out a free feasibility study to confirm.
faqs.question: Is my property suitable for geothermal energy?

faqs.answer: The Klimabonus, the Luxembourg State grant for certified residential geothermal installations, can be up to €10,000. Additional tax deductions may also apply. WDD helps you prepare the files.
faqs.question: What grants can I get in Luxembourg?

faqs.answer: Drilling takes 1 to 2 days for a single-family home. Installation of the heat pump by your heating installer takes a further 1 to 2 days. Total: less than a week.
